headline: Fenabrave Raises 2026 Brazil New Vehicle Sales Growth Forecast to 12.8%
summary: Brazilian motor vehicle distributor association Fenabrave raised its 2026 new vehicle sales growth projection from 8.6% to 12.8%. October registration data showed expanding overall momentum in the sector.
why: Fenabrave tracks national vehicle registration metrics in Brazil. New vehicle sales indicate broad consumer credit expansion and industrial output health in Latin America's largest economy.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Upward revisions to auto sales signal stronger underlying domestic demand and economic activity.
